objective: Render the already-bounded move.step.v1 tick, stagnation and maximum-progress evidence in the existing owner Desktop notice after every movement result.
non_goals: Do not change movement execution, freshness, authentication, retries, skill schemas or Mineflayer.
Do not add a new page, direct renderer network access, persistence, model call or raw telemetry.
Do not change Vision, Brain, Voice, avatar or resource scheduling.
contracts: The renderer receives only the existing bounded postcondition.progress fields through typed preload IPC.
The owner notice reports physics ticks, stagnant ticks and maximum forward progress for succeeded and failed movement.
No prompt, packet, bot object, world payload or unbounded vendor value is rendered.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Desktop dependencies only; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop types include the exact bounded movement progress shape.
The Minecraft movement notice renders all three evidence fields for success and failure.
Desktop typecheck/build/tests, module-brief validation, GitNexus scan and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M09-S5A-movement-evidence-presentation-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
